Boundary Fleece

A grid-fleece mid layer that breathes hard when you are moving and keeps enough warmth when you stop. The grid traps air without the bulk of a solid fleece, which means it works under a shell instead of fighting it.

Thumb loops, a chest pocket that takes a map, and a cut that does not ride up under a hip belt. It pills — all grid fleece does — and that does not affect how it works.

120 USD. Made in Portugal.
